objective: Screen two Defense First remainder candidates (DF01 published SPY fallback, DF02 SHY fallback) plus the DF00 no-change reference for whether redirecting S3's already-idle remainder into a published Defense First rotation (Carlson 2025) raises the design-window (2016-2023) Sharpe and cuts the drawdown versus plain SHY, beyond a momentum-free diversification control (EW) and 40 random-ranking placebos per candidate (RR-k), without breaking the frozen anchor-window return bar.

parameters.reuse_source: design-window metrics (s3_vt40_boost) from reports/paper/renewal/2026-09-23-s3-stress-2016-2023.json; anchor-window metrics from the authorized 2026-09-23 S1-S3 renewal record -- no new simulation required

parameters.cash_hurdle_test: asset_momentum_score < BIL_momentum_score -> slot fails, weight redirected to fallback asset
parameters.fallback_rule_source: published (Carlson 2025 / AllocateSmartly replication): failing slot -> SPY

parameters.cash_hurdle_test: asset_momentum_score < BIL_momentum_score -> slot fails, weight redirected to fallback asset
parameters.fallback_rule_source: this iteration's own disclosed departure from the published SPY fallback, to keep the remainder free of equity beta

data_v1_sip_daily_adjusted_defense_first.hygiene: drop bars with zero volume and zero trade_count
data_v1_sip_daily_adjusted_defense_first.source: alpaca SIP daily archive, fully adjusted closes

feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.momentum: close/lag(close,63)-1 for each S3 menu leg (TQQQ, SOXL, UPRO, USD, TECL) vs the same for SHY (absolute-momentum filter); top 2 legs held equal-weight. Unchanged from the live S3 book.
feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.realized_vol: 21-session stdev of the unscaled S3 book return, annualized; drives the remainder size (1 - risk-sleeve weight). Unchanged from the live S3 book.
feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.dip_trigger: QQQ close > 200-session SMA and QQQ 10-session Wilder RSI < 30 raises the volatility target from 0.40 to 0.60 for 10 sessions, unchanged from the live S3 book.
feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.defense_first_momentum_score: for each of TLT, GLD, DBC, UUP and the cash-hurdle instrument BIL: mean of the 1/3/6/12-calendar-month percent return measured from month-end closes (last trading day of each month), per claim_id carlson_defense_first_momentum_definition_allocatesmartly.
feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.defense_first_rank_and_weight: rank TLT/GLD/DBC/UUP by defense_first_momentum_score descending; assign 40/30/20/10 by rank; any asset whose score is below BIL's own score has its tier weight redirected to the candidate's fallback asset (SPY for DF01, SHY for DF02). RR-k placebos replace the rank assignment with a seeded random permutation, holding weights and the cash-hurdle screen fixed.
feature_v1_defense_first_remainder.defense_first_rebalance: decided on the last session of each calendar month at the close, applied from the next session's open; the remainder's dollar size still floats daily with S3's own vol-target/boost mechanics between Defense First decision dates.

label_v1_next_session_open_to_open_total.definition: weights effective at the next session open; return legs split open and close

validation_v1_design_window_then_anchor_.design: 2016-01-04..2023-09-15 (S3 itself first holds risk 2016-05-02; see warmup_first_valid_dates for the Defense First sleeve)
validation_v1_design_window_then_anchor_.anchor: 2024-01-08..2026-09-16 (do-no-harm check only, gate G1 at 10 and 20 bp)
validation_v1_design_window_then_anchor_.no_holdout_claim: 2026-01-02..2026-09-17 already spent evaluating the live S3 book at its 2026-09-23 renewal; not reused as an out-of-sample claim for DF01/DF02/EW/RR-k here

warmup_first_valid_dates.note: 63-session momentum/absolute-momentum-filter lookback warmup from the 2016-01-04 panel start; before this date S3 itself (and therefore every candidate's remainder) is flat/SHY by construction.
warmup_first_valid_dates.ew_first_valid: 2016-05-02 (no momentum lookback needed; valid as soon as S3 first has a remainder to hold -- a known, disclosed head-start over DF01/DF02/RR-k of about 9 months)
warmup_first_valid_dates.defense_first_momentum_score_first_valid: 2017-01-31 decision (close), applied from the 2017-02-03 open -- the 12-month component needs 12 completed prior calendar month-end closes; the first month-end close in the local archive is 2016-01-29, so the first month whose 12-month-prior month-end also exists is January 2017
warmup_first_valid_dates.df01_df02_rr_k_first_valid: 2017-02-03 (same as defense_first_momentum_score_first_valid); before this date DF01, DF02 and every RR-k placebo default to DF00's own behavior (remainder in SHY) -- a warmup limitation, not a lookahead bias, disclosed as an asymmetry against EW
effect: Before its first-valid date, the Defense First sleeve reads as inactive (same as DF00) by construction; this only affects the first ~9 months of the 2016-01-04..2023-09-15 design window and does not reach into the 2018 (-22.0%) or 2022 (-33.6%) drawdown episodes the design window exists to test.
